arxiv-2105-06189.title: Symmetry Origin of Baryon Asymmetry, Dark Matter and Neutrino Mass
arxiv-2105-06189.creator: Subhaditya Bhattacharya, Rishav Roshan, Arunansu Sil, Drona Vatsyayan
arxiv-2105-06189.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Subhaditya Bhattacharya, Rishav Roshan, Arunansu Sil, Drona Vatsyayan. We propose a minimal model based on lepton number symmetry (and violation), to address a common origin of baryon asymmetry, dark matter and neutrino mass generation.

arxiv-2208-12869.title: Optical and microwave metrology at the 10 -18 level with an Er/Yb:glass frequency comb
arxiv-2208-12869.creator: N. V. Nardelli, H. Leopardi, T. R. Schibli, T. M. Fortier
arxiv-2208-12869.description: Abstract Optical frequency combs are an essential tool for precision metrology experiments ranging in application from remote spectroscopic sensing of trace gases to the characterization and comparison of optical atomic clocks for precision time-keeping and searches for physics beyond the standard model.

arxiv-2302-05729.title: A Brief Report on LawGPT 1.0: A Virtual Legal Assistant Based on GPT-3
arxiv-2302-05729.creator: Nguyen Ha Thanh
arxiv-2302-05729.description: Abstract LawGPT 1.0 is a virtual legal assistant built on the state-of-the-art language model GPT-3, fine-tuned for the legal domain. The system is designed to provide legal assistance to users in a conversational manner, helping them with tasks such as answering legal questions, generating legal documents, and providing legal advice.

arxiv-2405-10011.title: Tetrahedron equation and Schur functions
arxiv-2405-10011.creator: Shinsuke Iwao, Kohei Motegi, and Ryo Ohkawa
arxiv-2405-10011.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shinsuke Iwao, Kohei Motegi, and Ryo Ohkawa. The tetrahedron equation introduced by Zamolodchikov is a three-dimensional generalization of the Yang-Baxter equation. Several types of solutions to the tetrahedron equation that have connections to quantum groups can be viewed as q q -oscillator valued vertex models with matrix elements of the L L -operators given by generators of the q q -oscillator algebra acting on the Fock space.

arxiv-2406-17776.title: Spectroscopic and Dynamic Orbital Analyses of Metal-Poor and High Proper Motion Stars: I. HD 8724 and HD 195633
arxiv-2406-17776.creator: M. Marışmak, T. Şahin*, F. Güney, O. Plevne, S. Bilir
arxiv-2406-17776.description: Abstract In this study, spectral, age, kinematic, and orbital dynamical analyses were conducted on metal-poor and high proper-motion (HPM) stars, HD 8724 and HD 195633, selected from the Solar neighborhood. This analysis combines detailed abundance measurements, kinematics, and orbital dynamics to determine their origin.

arxiv-2411-07319.title: Unsupervised machine learning phase classification for the Falicov-Kimball model
arxiv-2411-07319.creator: Lukáš Frk, Pavel Baláž, Elguja Archemashvili, Martin Žonda
arxiv-2411-07319.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Lukáš Frk, Pavel Baláž, Elguja Archemashvili, Martin Žonda. We apply various unsupervised machine learning methods for phase classification to investigate the finite-temperature phase diagram of the spinless Falicov-Kimball model in two dimensions. Using only particle occupation snapshots from Monte Carlo simulations as input, each technique, including a straightforward classification based on principal component analysis (PCA), successfully identifies the phase boundary between ordered and disordered phases, independent of the type of phase transition.

arxiv-2502-08805.title: Dark Matter Particle Flux in a Dynamically Self-consistent Milky Way Model
arxiv-2502-08805.creator: Lucijana Stanic 1, Mark Eberlein 1, Stanislav Linchakovskyy 1, Christopher Magnoli 1, Maryna Mesiura 1, Luca Morf 1, Prasenjit Saha 1, Eugene Vasiliev 2
arxiv-2502-08805.description: Abstract We extend a recently developed dynamically self-consistent model of the Milky Way constrained by observations from the Gaia observatory to include a radially anisotropic component in the dark matter (DM) halo, which represents the debris from the accreted Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus (GSE) galaxy.

arxiv-2503-22800.title: On the structure of open clusters: geometric vs geomantic astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 )
arxiv-2503-22800.creator: Lu Li (李璐), Zhengyi Shao（邵正义）
arxiv-2503-22800.description: Abstract Understanding our place in the universe is an eternal quest. Through the analysis of the 3D structures of 66 nearby open clusters using Gaia DR3 data, we discovered an intriguing pattern: most clusters show their elongation directions pointing at the Sun, suggesting that the Solar System might just be the universe’s favorite spot, a cosmic feng shui hotspot!

arxiv-2511-14282.title: Weight Variance Amplifier Improves Accuracy in High-Sparsity One-Shot Pruning
arxiv-2511-14282.creator: Vincent-Daniel Yun, Junhyuk Jo, Sunwoo Lee
arxiv-2511-14282.description: Abstract Deep neural networks achieve outstanding performance in visual recognition tasks, yet their large number of parameters makes them less practical for real-world applications. Recently, one-shot pruning has emerged as an effective strategy for reducing model size without additional training. However, models trained with standard objective functions often suffer a significant drop in accuracy after aggressive pruning.

pmc-10703774.title: Behavioral and physiological fatigue-related factors influencing timing and force control learning in pianists

pmc-10703774.description: Optimizing the training regimen depending on neuromuscular fatigue is crucial for the well-being of professionals intensively practicing motor skills, such as athletes and musicians, as persistent fatigue can hinder learning and cause neuromuscular injuries. pmc-12610832.creator: Annabel Z Shen, Mohamad Taha, Mahmoud Ghannoum, Stephen K Tyring, Gianluca Nazzaro
pmc-12610832.description: Introduction: Chronic wounds are a growing healthcare challenge, with infections being major complications that delay healing. Biofilms are structured microbial communities encased in extracellular polymeric substances. Biofilms confer antimicrobial resistance, promote inflammation, and protect pathogens from host defenses. These mechanisms make eradication difficult with standard therapies.

pmc-13589045.creator: Wiput Laosuksri, Borwon Wittayachamnankul, Siriporn C Chattipakorn, Nipon Chattipakorn
